(2) A medium shot follows, showing a line of customers standing inside a brightly lit restaurant with white walls and arched doorways. (3) The camera focuses on a prepared bento box featuring curry rice, a halved hard-boiled egg, sliced cucumbers, and a piece of purple sweet potato, with fried chicken in a bamboo basket nearby. (4) A close-up shows a pair of metal chopsticks lifting instant noodles from a white bowl with 'Thai Cuisine' text, as a runny egg yolk breaks over the shrimp and squid. (5) A hand is shown depressing a lever on a metallic dispenser to pour a golden-colored soup into a small paper cup. (6) Several close-up shots highlight a specific dish called Curry Egg with Crab Meat Rice, showing generous portions of white crab meat on top of the egg mixture. (7) A spoon scoops up a portion of the rice and curry, showing a moist and creamy texture. (8) The scene shifts to a close-up of Lemongrass Grilled Chicken Leg, showing charred skin being picked up with chopsticks. (9) Further close-ups show side dishes like shrimp paste cabbage and green vegetables being lifted. (10) A vibrant bowl of Mama Noodles is showcased with large shrimp, squid rings, and various herbs. (11) A small bamboo basket containing deep-fried Jiaoma Chicken Wings sprinkled with white seasoning is shown in close-up. (12) A plastic container of sticky rice topped with sliced strawberries is drizzled with condensed milk. (13) Two large plastic cups of Thai milk tea, one orange and one green, are presented. (14) The video concludes with a shot of the menu and the exterior storefront featuring the brand name in Chinese.
